newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev firms ahead of rate rise.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev firms ahead of rate rise.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed around 1,570-1,572 per dollar, slightly firmer from the morning's 1,572-1,574 as a new higher main interest rate was to take effect next week, dealers said.
"Foreign currency demand from end customers was high today but supply topped it and the lev edged up," a dealer said.
Banks and clients were offering foreign currency for levs either to meet pending payments or to invest in government securities ahead of new main rate going into force on Monday.
The central bank was seen buying dollars at around 1,570 levs to contain a lev rise in the afternoon, traders said. Central bank officials were not available for comment.
The central bank said on Thursday it will raise its main rate to 48.72 percent annually from 43.08 percent.
The rate hike could boost investor interest in floating interest T-bills at Monday's auctions, traders said.
